desc: Whether you are looking for a firearm to take to the range for some weekend fun, defend your homestead with, or a great companion by your side in the field Tokarev have a model to fit your needs. Their modern designs mixed with utilitarian features give you a rugged, and functional firearm for any situation. Backed by their Lifetime Service Plan, they bring a combination of performance, value, and commitment to customer service to a broad range of firearms enthusiasts.
